2: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. Yahweh is great and very worthy of praise in the city of our God, in his ⌞holy mountain⌟.
3: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is ⌞Mount Zion⌟, ⌞in the far north⌟, the city of the great king.
4: God is in her citadels; he is known as a high stronghold.
5: For see, the kings assembled; they advanced together.
6: ⌞They themselves saw⌟ it, so they were astonished. They were terrified; they ran off.
7: Trembling seized them there— pain as of a woman in labor.
8: With an east wind you shatter the ships of Tarshish.
9: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of Yahweh of hosts, in the city of our God. God will establish her forever. Selah
10: We have pondered your loyal love, O God, in the midst of your temple.
11: As is your name, O God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
12: Let ⌞Mount Zion⌟ rejoice; let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
13: Walk about Zion and circle it; count her towers.
14: ⌞Consider well⌟ her ramparts. Go through her citadels so that you can tell the next generation
15: that this is God, our God forever and ever. ⌞He himself⌟ will guide us until death.
